profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a London-based AI video platform that describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business. The company's site claims the platform is trusted by more than 90% of the Fortune 100 to create video content for internal communications, training, and workforce upskilling. It supports more than 160 languages and, according to the site, can save users up to 90% of time and cost compared with traditional video production by eliminating the need for cameras, microphones, actors, or studios.

The core product is an AI video generator built around AI avatars and voiceovers. Features listed on the site include a custom avatar builder, AI voice cloning, a PowerPoint-to-video converter, an AI video editor, interactive avatars, roleplay sessions, and an AI screen recorder, among others. The platform integrates with Learning Management Systems for embedding videos directly into training courses, and Synthesia describes it as designed for brand consistency through logo, color, and style controls. A free plan is available that includes 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and access to AI voices across all supported languages. The company states the platform is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, and it labels AI-generated content in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

The site's held facts list Synthesia's video generation product under the category of Video Generation and Editing, with a noted risk area around AI avatars and likeness and consent. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
